title: tragacantha cracca
intro: Tragacantha cracca, commonly known as Lesser Burnet, is a flowering plant in the legume family Fabaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Tragacantha cracca include its ability to reduce inflammation and modulate the immune system, making it a potential treatment for various conditions, including arthritis and other inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and offer protection against oxidative stress and inflammation.
